lead: Choose the model the Keeper's background lanes use: writing an item's parameters, and auditing an unpublished draft for mechanics it never declared.
aside: Nothing these lanes write reaches the player, so a quick model here shortens every turn without touching a word of the prose.
restart: Both choices are read when a session starts. Change them, then open a new session: a table that is already running keeps the ones it started with.
auto_subtitle: The lanes run on whichever model the Keeper is set to
thinking_lead: Choose the reasoning effort those lanes run at. A review has a fixed time budget, and on a high-effort table one can spend all of it thinking and deliver nothing.
thinking_auto_subtitle: The lanes run at whichever level the Keeper is set to
empty: No models in Model Management yet. Sign in a provider there, then come back.
failed: Reading or writing the lane model failed; try again.
